translations.web: The words of the wise are like goads; and like nails well fastened are words from the masters of assemblies, which are given from one shepherd.
translations.bsb: The words of the wise are like goads, and the anthologies of the masters are like firmly embedded nails driven by a single Shepherd.
translations.kjv: The words of the wise are as goads, and as nails fastened by the masters of assemblies, which are given from one shepherd.
translations.asv: The words of the wise are as goads; and as nails well fastened are the words of the masters of assemblies, which are given from one shepherd.
